reason: Waiting for replacement notarization of the corrected universal-helper archive before Homebrew publication
summary: Diagnosed a universal MCP helper signing defect, repaired and verified the Release scheme, and paused for replacement Apple notarization before Homebrew publication.
progress: Verified that /Applications/Disk Steward.app and the prior archive had the canonical helper identifier but an invalid universal helper signature.
Reproduced the defect in a clean archive and proved that each thin architecture was valid while the fat Mach-O container failed verification.
Added release finalization that signs the helper, reconstructs the universal container from its valid slices, re-signs the enclosing app, and verifies the complete bundle.
Added the finalizer as a Release scheme archive post-action and retained an in-build helper signing check for non-archive Release builds.

Built and verified /private/tmp/DiskSteward-1.0.0-final.xcarchive; all signature, identity, entitlement, timestamp, runtime, and architecture checks pass, and only the expected missing notarization staple gate remains.
Committed and pushed the repair as 484a593, then opened the exact final archive in Xcode Organizer.

checks.notes: Five focused distribution tests passed with zero failures.

checks.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project DiskSteward.xcodeproj -scheme DiskSteward-Release -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=macOS -archivePath /private/tmp/DiskSteward-1.0.0-final.xcarchive archive
checks.notes: The real Release scheme and archive post-action completed successfully.
Both universal helper slices and the enclosing app satisfy their Developer ID designated requirements.
All pre-notarization checks pass; exit occurs only at the expected missing staple gate.
Commit 484a593 is published on KMerdan/disk_steward main.

decisions.decision: Reconstruct the universal helper container after signing its slices.
decisions.rationale: On macOS 15, codesign produced two valid thin slices but left stale fat-container offsets; lipo reconstruction yields a persistently valid universal executable.

decisions.decision: Run final release signing as an Archive post-action.
decisions.rationale: Archive deployment processing occurs after normal target post-build scripts and can otherwise invalidate the nested helper; the scheme post-action establishes the final distributable state.

assumptions: The user will upload the exact archive named DiskSteward-1.0.0-final created around 18:16 JST, not the earlier fixed or installed copies.
Apple notarization must be repeated because the repaired artifact has new code-directory hashes.
blockers: The user must select /private/tmp/DiskSteward-1.0.0-final.xcarchive in Xcode Organizer, choose Distribute App > Developer ID > Upload, wait for Ready to distribute, and export the notarized app.
risks: The current /Applications/Disk Steward.app is signature-invalid and must not be used for the GitHub or Homebrew artifact.
Publishing the cask before the replacement notarized app passes verify-release would ship a Gatekeeper-rejected build.
